summary: City camping page read: electric + water hookups, bathrooms and showers, $30/night ($200/week, $400/month, tents $15). No site count, amperage or booking rule stated; booking left as stored. Note's '$40/week' was wrong and is cleaned. Campsites not identifiable on imagery.
flags: PIN UNCONFIRMED: stored 47.83050,-98.43830 falls in the outfield of the ballfield north of the school (north end of town). Imagery shows a gravel lane with small buildings along the north and west sides of the field (~47.8312,-98.4392) but no visible RV pads or parked campers; the city pages give no address. Google's 'Tolna City Park Campground' pin is 47.82722,-98.44010 (~390 m SSW, on Main St downtown), which looks like a geocode rather than the park. Reviewer may want the city to confirm where the sites are.

SITES: no count published, and HHS's licensed list (07.17.2025) has no Tolna City Park line (the licensed Tolna RV park is the private PRAIRIE VIEW RV LLP, 301 Winter Ave E, 15 lots, whose row of units shows on imagery at the east edge of town ~47.8283,-98.4352). Fit for a 23-ft rig not stated; the stored entry already assumes it.

BOOKING: stored reservable false / fcfs always (derived) is not stated for the city park (the 'first come first serve' line on the recreation page is Tolna Dam's); the old fees note said 'book by phone'. Page silent, left as stored; the fees note no longer claims phone booking.
LONG-STAY: nightly $30 is the lead rate beside weekly/monthly; no discouraging wording. Google 3.7 stars / 3 reviews (thin). Not evidently mostly seasonal.
PHONE: stored 701-262-4749 is on Google but not on the city pages; the city's camping page lists 701-230-0356 (also stored on Tolna Dam) and 701-429-3103. Suggest 701-262-4749 -> 701-230-0356.
WEBSITE: https://tolnand.govoffice.com/recreation -> https://tolnand.govoffice.com/camping (the city's own camping rates page; the recreation page still works).

LEAD: Nelson County Stump Lake Park Campground (63 Pavilion Rd, Pekin; Nelson County Park Board, 130 lots on HHS; city page: 'Stump Lake Park - nightly & seasonal rentals - RV and tents. Hookups, showers and bathrooms and restaurant'). No 'Stump Lake' entry in campgrounds.json and nothing within 30 km of 47.86,-98.30. Not vetted. (Tolna Bay Campground is described as 'seasonal rentals' only: not a lead.)
HORSES (AWH rule 2026-11-12): the City of Tolna camping and recreation pages are silent on horses; imagery shows no horse facilities at the ballfield park. Not a horse campground; keep.
